skins.name: Nighttime Café
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Nighttime Café. Always meticulous, Ansel likes to be properly dressed at the café as well. He steadfastly refuses to sell coffee at night, however.
skins.quote: 'If nocturnality is a racial trait, couldn't you at least provide coffee at night for other Cautus operators? No? But you drink it every night!'
